transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom. My name is Nisha. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi Nisha, I'm Aisha Reddy. I'm calling because I've had enough of the constant signal drops in my area. It's completely unacceptable.
Agent: I am very sorry to hear that you've been experiencing connectivity issues, Ms. Reddy. I can certainly look into this for you.
Customer: I don't want it looked into anymore. I just want to cancel my service.
Agent: I understand. Before we proceed with any account changes, could you please provide your account number?
Customer: My account number is 14182295.
Agent: Thank you. And just to confirm, is your phone number 91913 66527 and your email aisha.91@examplemail.com?
Customer: Yes, that's correct.
Agent: I see the account here. I can start the process to close the account for you.
Customer: Fine. I also have an outstanding balance of twenty dollars that I want to pay now so there are no issues later.
Agent: I can take that payment. Please go ahead and read me your card details.
Customer: It is four seven eight zero zero eight three seven four zero seven one eight eight one six.
Agent: Thank you. I have processed that payment.
Customer: This is ridiculous. I've spent hours on the phone over the last month and I'm still just paying to leave. This is the worst service I've ever had.
Agent: I apologize for the frustration this has caused you.
Customer: Apologies don't fix my signal! I'm done with this company.
Agent: Is there anything else I can assist you with today? I will submit the cancellation request now. Goodbye.
